amendments.AM01: Hybrid Python/Rust; preserve reliable facilities; full future Rust migration requires semantic evidence.

amendments.AM08: Build review/flaw machinery; defer real project flaw campaigns.

amendments.AM11: Durable budgets, bounded retries, exact freshness and reuse; unknown costs remain unknown; no invented token budget.
amendments.AM12: Complete nominal/structural/behavioral correspondence, compiler-backed reconciliation and independent CPGSchema qualification.
amendments.AM13: Lossless retained source corpus, exact retrieval, focused skills and every research recommendation disposition.
amendments.AM14: Controlled macro provenance and single generated-region owner; proc_macro2 is infrastructure.
amendments.AM15: Human proof packets and scoped fresh decisions; a review cannot manufacture a proof.
amendments.AM16: Dagger/GitLab, dev-based stacked integration, .agents deployment, .aegis state and last-accepted governance.
amendments.AM17: Preserve full Linux acceptance and portable core; retain explicit future Windows/macOS obligations.
amendments.AM18: Separate implementation, domain verification, project completion and CGP completion; retire conflicting policy without deleting historical evidence.
amendments.AM19: Roadmap package completion is distinct from implementation of the three projects; launchers remain inactive.
